Show up on the boring days. That is where progress hides.

Nobody films the quiet reps. Nobody cheers for the workout you almost skipped. But those are the ones that add up. Keep it simple, keep it steady, and let the work stack. 💪

quote: Rest is part of the plan, not a break from it.
caption:
Rest is part of the plan, not a break from it.

Sunday is for easy movement and loose hips. You don't earn recovery by being tired. You schedule it, because that's when your body absorbs the work. Take today seriously and show up fresh tomorrow. 💪
